method: A/1440 focused verification followed by the other five variant/viewport scenarios; no full six-case rerun claimed. Same recursively frozen eight-source/nine-version/six-entry fixture at every initial capture. After visible-reading-focus and decorative truncation marker changes, only expansion/original-back/collapse and six normal captures were rechecked; initial edit/state captures and complete-flow checks retained separately.
